annotations.title: EV charging points in Poland (UDT EIPA)

description: Public EV charging in Poland from the UDT register EIPA: locations, stations and charging points today and at each month end since December 2019, growth year on year, charging sites and fast sites (at least 50 kW) by province and county, sites per 10k residents, sites by maximum power class (EU AFIR: up to 22 kW, 23-49, 50-149, 150-349, 350+ kW) and connector (CCS, Type 2, CHAdeMO), counties with the most ultra-fast sites (150 kW and more), networks with the most fast sites, and the finwire index finwire_ev_charging_coverage (charging points per 1000 BEV and PHEV cars in the fleet). Interactive map with every site: finwire.pl/mapa-ladowarek.
